lesson.goal: Use three types of cohesive device accurately in a Task 2 body paragraph.

warmup.instruction: Recall one thing you find hard about writing.

teach.explanation: Cohesion is how your ideas connect. Band 6+ writing links sentences with a mix of reference (this, such), conjunctions (however, moreover, despite), and substitution. Weak writing either omits links or overuses and/also. Aim for variety: open with a topic sentence, add a reason with because/since, concede with although/despite, and contrast with however. Use this to refer back to a whole idea.
examples: Despite the high cost, studying abroad builds independence.
Many students struggle at first; however, they adapt within weeks.
Universities offer support such as mentoring and language classes.

items.prompt: ___ the expense, the experience is worthwhile.
items.feedback: Despite + noun phrase; Although needs a full clause.

items.prompt: It is hard at first; ___, most students adapt.
items.feedback: Use a contrast linker after a semicolon, not a reason.

items.prompt: Cities are crowded ___ they offer more jobs.
items.feedback: A reason is needed here, so use because.

items.prompt: Costs are rising. ___ trend worries families.
items.feedback: This refers back to the whole previous idea.

produce.instruction: Write one Task 2 body paragraph (4-5 sentences) using despite, however, and a this-reference.
produce.prefill: Some people believe that university should be free for all students.

review.tip: Link ideas, do not just list them - variety of linkers signals a higher band.
